sourceSupplements.pointerScope: Trusted browser touch events on supplied controller assets; controlled local WebSocket transport. Actual TV response is a separately labelled host fixture.
sourceSupplements.protocolScope: Controlled public native-host input snapshots with the real shared runtime and production game. Separate from trusted controller touch transport; no physical Android/LAN/phone claim.

findings.message: Each task requires a checked complete ordinary win and natural four-rejection loss.

sparseCandidateAudit.scope: Auditor accepts single-task endpoint runs; explicit menu/retry boundaries delimit domains. No calls, input timing or continuous transitions fabricated; first findings preserved.
limitations: Arithmetic checks establish consistency of recorded public facts, not source execution or artifact authenticity.
No Model, renderer, pilot, formal-test source, private witness or diagnostic corpus is read or imported.
Each transition starts from its actual recorded before state. Calculated states never become later observations.
Sparse endpoints do not establish intervening calls, held-input continuity, undo history transitions or ordinary reachability.
JSON cannot establish fresh object identity, accessor/Proxy behavior, missing native values or the truth of display prose.
Model consistency does not establish browser lifecycle, trusted touch handling, visuals, performance or physical-device behavior.
Only manifest-listed public artifacts are read; this audit cannot establish that unlisted attempts do not exist.
Origin source hashes are provenance claims. Production, pilot, renderer and harness sources are not opened or authenticated.
Sparse endpoints and their gaps cannot replace a complete ordinary model-call chain or prove browser lifecycle, trusted controls, visuals or hardware behavior.
JSON cannot establish fresh reference identity, descriptor/getter/Proxy behavior, or unrecorded input properties.

encodedOriginals.scope: All12decodedPNGs and12mappedsourceJPEG originals personallyopened max2perbatch. Actualpixels classified independently of sparse nearby observationlabels; no exactframe/model or hardwareFPSclaim.
limitations: This is an original-still review of 12 mapped decoded/source pairs, not a personal full-motion review of every encoded frame.
Sparse browser state read boundaries and reception-clock proximity do not identify exact physical state for each encoded frame. Visible states above are classified from pixels independently.
The recording report retained separately reports successful full decode and terminal sparse-state agreement; this peer review did not execute another decode or recapture.

The three menus are covered, while active gameplay in this recording sample set is Courtyard. Other task play, pause, natural loss, 960-width layout and phone controls were reviewed in separate final QA or supplementary original-image evidence.
Facade colors encode visible roof-owner columns, not full per-height geometric occlusion. Anchor and silhouette correctness depend on the separately reviewed public model.
No physical television or phone performance claim is made. 30 fps is the export rate, not measured hardware fps.
